title: Chest pain at the microbus stand

patient.name: عم سيد
patient.hook: سواق ميكروباص، بيشرب سجاير من وهو عنده ١٥ سنة

complaint: صدري تقيل أوي، كأن فيه طوبة عليه، من ساعة
arrival: زمايله في الموقف جابوه على الطوارئ بالعربية

history.q: الوجع بدأ إمتى وإنت بتعمل إيه؟
history.a: من حوالي ساعة، وأنا بنزّل الركاب. ماوقفش من ساعتها
عرقت جامد، وحاسس إني عايز أرجّع
الضغط عالي، والسكر بقالي سنتين ومش منتظم على العلاج
حباية ضغط وحباية سكر، ساعات بنساهم
فول وطعمية الصبح، زي كل يوم

exam.label: General look
exam.finding: Anxious, sweaty, pale, clutching his chest

exam.label: Heart sounds
exam.finding: S1 and S2 normal, no murmur, no rub

ecgTask.prompt: Tap the leads with ST elevation

steps.label: Aspirin loading dose
steps.why: Irreversibly inhibits platelet COX-1/thromboxane A2 to halt thrombus propagation; give non-enteric chewed aspirin immediately in every suspected ACS.

steps.label: Call the cath lab for primary PCI
steps.why: ST elevation in V1–V4 is an anterior STEMI: mechanical reperfusion via primary PCI within 120 min of diagnosis saves myocardium and lowers mortality.

steps.label: P2Y12 loading
steps.why: Potent dual antiplatelet therapy with aspirin prevents acute stent thrombosis and reinfarction; ticagrelor 180 mg load acts rapidly.

steps.label: Unfractionated heparin at PCI
steps.why: Parenteral anticoagulation (70–100 U/kg IV bolus without GP IIb/IIIa) prevents catheter-related thrombosis during primary PCI.

steps.label: High-intensity statin
steps.why: High-intensity atorvastatin 80 mg started early stabilizes vulnerable coronary plaques and reduces recurrent ischemic events regardless of baseline LDL.

steps.label: Morphine 2–4 mg IV if the pain goes on
steps.why: Relieves refractory ischemic pain and sympathetic surge, though it may delay oral P2Y12 absorption and does not treat the occlusion.

steps.label: Oxygen by face mask
steps.why: His SpO2 is 97%. In normoxic ACS (SpO2 ≥90%), routine oxygen causes hyperoxia-induced coronary vasoconstriction without benefit.

steps.label: Wait for the troponin before calling cardiology
steps.why: STEMI is an ECG diagnosis. Waiting for troponin adds avoidable ischemia time and costs salvageable anterior myocardium.

steps.label: Give tenecteplase now
steps.why: Primary PCI is preferred over fibrinolysis whenever wire-crossing is achievable within 120 minutes, giving higher patency and less ICH.

steps.label: DC shock 200 J
steps.why: Ventricular fibrillation requires immediate unsynchronized biphasic defibrillation to restore perfusing sinus rhythm.

steps.label: Explain to him and his family what is happening and what comes next
steps.why: A heart attack is terrifying. A few calm, plain words about the cath lab plan lower fear and help him cooperate.

steps.label: Get his consent for primary PCI after explaining the benefit and main risks
steps.why: He is awake and has capacity, so he decides. An emergency shortens the talk; it does not remove it.

steps.label: Post his ECG with his name in a doctors' WhatsApp group to ask for opinions
steps.why: Sharing identifiable patient data in a group breaks confidentiality. Ask your senior or cardiology directly, or remove every identifier.

deterioration.event: VF on the monitor — he is not responding

outcomes.best: الشريان اتفتح في القسطرة بعد ٤٠ دقيقة. عم سيد رجع الموقف بعد شهر، وبطّل السجاير.
outcomes.delay: اتفتح الشريان، بس متأخر. القلب بقى أضعف، وبينهج على السلم.
outcomes.missed: التشخيص اتأخر، وجزء كبير من عضلة القلب راح.
outcomes.trap: الغلطة دي أخرت العلاج، والعضلة اللي ماتت مش هترجع.
outcomes.death: ماتلحقش. زمايله لسه مستنيينه في الموقف.

ecgGuide: ST elevation ≥2 mm in precordial leads V1–V4 localizes acute anterior wall myocardial infarction from proximal LAD occlusion, with reciprocal ST depression in inferior leads II, III, and aVF.
teaching: STEMI is diagnosed on the ECG. Aspirin and the cath lab come first; the troponin does not change the decision.
